title: More Splashes
description: Splish-splash! A resource pack for Minecraft 1.21.4 that adds more splash texts.
body:
![More Splashes logo](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/7ac1b7adc2879b8854f6a9693b08b2af5589802c.png)
### A resource pack for Minecraft 1.21.4 that adds more splash texts.

Mod by Zharkou.

**What does it do?**

More Splashes does just that, it adds more splash texts to the title screen. Some are from other versions of the game, others are unique to More Splashes.

**What do they reference?**

Mostly just various things I like, but they try to stay true to Mojang's style. If you could contribute (I'm zharkou on Discord), I would greatly appreciate it!

**How does the version system work?**

To change the third number (x.x.**x**), a version needs to make or change less than 5 splash texts. To change the second number (x.**x**.x), a version needs to make or change less than 35 but more than 5 splash texts. To change the first number (**x**.x.x), a version needs to make or change more than 35 splash texts.

**How'd you make it?**

MCreator for the win!

**Is it coming to newer/older versions?**

That will happen after More Splashes is out of beta.
